Clarification required. Planning ref: `stable` @ `2ad4b6b64a09c922a8cd7dd2c771ebc1b868bdbb` (symbolic `heads/stable`). Integration branch mismatch: `false`.

The auto-selected answer `Q1: A` cannot be acted on. Its own condition was "answer A only after #8376's port PR has merged into `stable`", and this tree does not meet it. #8376 has merged, but it did not bring the port the re-plan was supposed to build on:

- **What #8376 actually shipped:** `changelog.d/8376-implement-stall-diagnostics.md` describes `stall-diag` logging that runs only when the implement phase gives up. It says plainly that the 30-minute limit is unchanged. It also says the newer tracker that follows the working run is on the default branch but not on `stable` yet.
- **`IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING` is missing:** it does not appear anywhere in `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`, the test files or `changelog.d/`.
- **The step-name signal still reads the newest run:** it uses `IMPL_RUN_ID_LATEST` (around lines 1634-1636). That variable is set to the most recently created run, not a running one (around line 1527). A `pending` duplicate therefore still hides the run doing the work.
- **No gate-step limit:** there is no 35-minute allowance for `Pre-push affected-test gate`. The timer resets only when the state string on line 1643 changes.
- **No main-branch copy here:** this workspace is not a git repository, so `isolated-base` does not exist. I cannot read the `main` code from #8243 or #8259 to port it hunk for hunk.

**What each path means for the replay of run 40932430968:**

- **D1 alone:** the window opens at 19:01:15, so working run 40936238289 is counted. The step signal still reads pending run 40936365554, though, so Phase 3b would still stop at about 19:37. The counterfactual would be FAIL.
- **D1 with the working-run choice but no gate-step limit:** the 30 min 42 s gate step would still trip the 30-minute limit at about 19:44:54.
- **Only D1, the working-run choice and a gate-step limit of 35 minutes or more together** meet acceptance item 3 from your direction.

> **Q1: #8376 merged into `stable` without porting `IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING` or the 35-minute gate-step limit. Only its stall diagnostics landed. How should this heal proceed?**
>
> Choices:
> - **A** — Proceed now against current `stable` and include all three pieces in this PR. D1 sets `approved_at` to the earliest trusted `/approved`. A working-run choice for the step-name signal prefers an `in_progress` run, falls back to the newest one, and uses the name `IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING` so it matches `main`. The step-name signal also gets a 35-minute limit for `Pre-push affected-test gate`. The full replay test from your direction is included, and the PR body carries a "Port to main" note for the D1 change only. The reason for dropping D2 earlier was that #8376 would port it, which no longer holds, and #8376 is merged, so the two cannot conflict. Risk: the code is written from the issue's description because `main` cannot be read here, so it may differ textually from #8243/#8259 on `main`. (RECOMMENDED)
> - **B** — Proceed now with D1 only, as directed. The replay test checks only that `approved_at` equals the plan's auto-approval time (19:01:15) and that the working run is inside Phase 3b's window. The counterfactual will be `FAIL`, because the step signal still reads the pending duplicate, so a human has to approve the plan.
> - **C** — Keep waiting. A separate PR first ports `IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING` and the gate-step limit from `main` to `stable`. Answer only after that PR has merged into `stable`, and name the PR or commit in the answer. Do not pick this option through a stall auto-answer: on the current tree it would loop again.
>
> Reply: `Q1: A`
